guarantees.claim: vec_c[i] = XOR over j=0..7 of (mat_a[j][i] & vec_b[7-j])

uncertain_points.claim: The vector input vec_b is indexed in reverse order (7-j), while j corresponds to row index of mat_a. The intended matrix-vector multiplication may require non-reversed vec_b[j] indexing.
uncertain_points.cond: If this function is intended to implement standard GF(2) matrix-vector multiplication for AES MixColumns or similar, the reversed bit order could produce an incorrect result, potentially breaking cryptographic correctness.
uncertain_points.risk: If this function is used in AES operations, the cipher output would be wrong, leading to data corruption or interoperability failure.
